entries.title: I Corinthians 16:1
segments: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:2
segments: Upon the first day of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:3
segments: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:4
segments: and if it be meet for me to go also, they shall go with me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:5
segments: But I will come unto you, when I shall have passed through Macedonia; for I pass through Macedonia;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:6
segments: but with you it may be that I shall abide, or even winter, that ye may set me forward on my journey whithersoever I go.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:7
segments: For I do not wish to see you now by the way; for I hope to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:8
segments: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost;

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:9
segments: for a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:10
segments: Now if Timothy come, see that he be with you without fear; for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do:

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:11
segments: let no man therefore despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come unto me: for I expect him with the brethren.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:12
segments: But as touching Apollos the brother, I besought him much to come unto you with the brethren: and it was not all [his] will to come now; but he will come when he shall have opportunity.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:13
segments: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:14
segments: Let all that ye do be done in love.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:15
segments: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:16
segments: that ye also be in subjection unto such, and to every one that helpeth in the work and laboreth.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:17
segments: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:18
segments: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:19
segments: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Prisca salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:20
segments: All the brethren salute you. Salute one another with a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:21
segments: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:22
segments: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:23
segments: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 16:24
segments: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
